source_row.rationale: Beta blockers can mask warning manifestations such as tachycardia. Current labeling also notes that severe or prolonged hypoglycemia can occur and that nonselective beta blockade may delay recovery of serum glucose. Patients at risk require monitoring rather than blanket avoidance of the class.
source_row.source_detail: Warnings and Precautions 5.6 Hypoglycemia: masking tachycardia and risk of severe or prolonged hypoglycemia; current label accessed 2026-08-14.
